name: What causes kitchen door frames to split, sag, or stick?

mainEntity.name: What causes kitchen door frames to split, sag, or stick?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common causes include high humidity and steam from cooking, minor water leaks from nearby dishwashers or sinks, normal house settling, and frequent impact. In kitchens, repeated slamming or heavy pantry traffic can also loosen hinge screws within the jamb over time. Before scheduling a repair, it helps to check whether surrounding drywall is cracked or if moisture is actively softening the wood base, as resolving any underlying water leak is essential before completing carpentry and finish repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen frames typically fail due to cooking humidity, nearby plumbing leaks, loose hinges from frequent use, or normal structural settling that pushes the jamb out of plumb.
